name: High School Apprenticeships (Open Village Season)
what_you_do: Learn an old trade like tinsmithing or broom making. Or help the education team behind the scenes. You also practice customer service and public history skills during Open Village.
grades: Grades 9 to 12 (rising 9th graders can start in the fall)
who_can_apply: New York City high school students ages 14 to 18 in grades 9 to 12. Space is limited.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated. The page calls it a service learning experience.
duration: July and August, up to 3 days a week, Wednesday to Sunday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.
deadline_text: The interest form opens each March. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form on the Apprenticeships page when it opens each March.
notes: Pay is not stated, so ask whether it is paid and whether working papers are needed. The site says the program has run for decades.
